description: Renovate is switched off in this repository on purpose. Dependabot proposes every dependency update here, and .github/dependabot.yml is the dependency policy: which manifests move, grouped how, how often and after what cooldown, with Conventional Commit messages the release notes understand.

Run beside Dependabot, Renovate duplicates every update as an ungrouped pull request of its own, with commit subjects ('Update module ...') that the conventional-commits check refuses, and applies none of that policy. This matches nauthera-server, which made the same choice.
Keep this file. With no repository configuration Renovate falls back to the organisation's defaults, which is how it came to run here.
